visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short black hair wearing a white tank top sits on a grey couch. She holds a brown teddy bear in her left hand and gestures with her right. In front of her on a wooden table, an Apple Watch is displayed. The lighting is bright and even. (2) The scene transitions to a series of product images against dynamic backgrounds. First, an Apple Watch Series 10 with a golden radiating dial. Then, a Garmin Fenix 8 with a yellow strap and rugged interface. Following is another Garmin Solar version with icons for various sports. Next is an Oppo Watch X2 with a round dark face. Finally, a Google Pixel Watch 3 with a white strap is shown. (3) The camera returns to the woman. She is more animated now, leaning forward toward the lens. She uses her hands to emphasize her points about battery life and features. The background remains the grey couch and a white brick-patterned wall. The video ends with her face close to the camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A female voice speaks rapidly in Mandarin with an energetic and slightly critical tone. A rhythmic, high-tempo electronic BGM plays continuously in the background. Faint rustling of clothing can be heard as the speaker moves her arms. The audio is clear and studio-quality. (2) The voice continues narrating technical specifications. The BGM maintains its upbeat tempo without interruption. Subtle digital transition sound effects mark the rhythmic changes corresponding to the visual slides of different smartwatch products. The vocal delivery is consistent and enunciated. (3) The vocal intensity increases significantly as the speaker adopts a more dramatic and demanding tone. She shouts for answers with high arousal. At the very end, a short comical variety-show sound effect plays, accompanied by a brief burst of synthetic canned laughter and applause.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To critique the battery life of the Apple Watch Series 10 by comparing it with competitors like Garmin, Oppo, and Google, highlighting a decline in sales and consumer dissatisfaction with battery performance.
